text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services has assessed the feasibility and is recommending the installation of speed bumps in the public lane west of Gilbert Avenue, north of Innes Avenue.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of speed bumps in the public lane west of Gilbert Avenue, between Innes Avenue and Rogers Road, as shown in Attachment 1, Drawing TC-137 dated April 2023, to the report (May 5, 2023) from the Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services.
